name: assignStumpToQuadrant
shortDescription: Links a Stump participant to a specific Quadrant within a Molecule, enabling task and deliverable assignments.
description:
Overview

Creates a QuadrantParticipant record to associate a User (Stump) with a Quadrant within a Molecule.

Intended use

Called by the Lead Point persona from the Quadrant and Participant Detail View UI to assign responsibilities. Parameters include quadrantId, stumpId, and moleculeId.

Logic

  1. Validate that params.quadrantId exists by querying the Quadrant entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Validate that params.stumpId corresponds to an existing User with the stump app role. If not found or not a Stump, return an error.
  3. Validate that params.moleculeId exists by querying the Molecule entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  4. Check if a QuadrantParticipant record already exists for the given quadrantId and stumpId using ctx.data.query. If it does, return a conflict error or the existing record.
  5. Create a new QuadrantParticipant record using ctx.data.create with quadrantId, stumpId, moleculeId, and assignedByUserId (from ctx.user_id).
  6. Audit-log the assignment using ctx.audit.log, including the quadrant and stump IDs.
  7. Return the created QuadrantParticipant record.

Entities

  • QuadrantParticipant
  • Quadrant
  • User
  • Molecule
